summary: Sandbach United had a tough pre-season friendly against St Helens recently, with the visitors making their chances count in a closely contested match. The Ramblers are gearing up for an exciting 26/27 campaign with three brand new kits, several fresh signings, and at least one returning player to bolster the squad. With just one week until the season kicks off, the club is also actively seeking sponsorship opportunities and fans are urged to get behind the team in their push for promotion.
